title: RIACT: A Responsible AI System for Personalized Study Habit Tracking and Early Burnout Signal Detection in University Students
abstract: arXiv:2608.21379v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Student burnout is highly prevalent in higher education, with reported rates ranging from 12% to over 70% and consistently exceeding those of the working population - yet it is typically identified only retrospectively, after academic decline has already occurred. A contributing factor is that students have little structured visibility into their own study behaviour, and existing productivity tools record activity without interpreting it. This paper presents RIACT (Record, Insight, Analyze, Coach, Track), a web-based application that combines structured study session logging with a hybrid AI architecture to surface personalized insights and early burnout signals. Students log sessions by location and time; the system computes net focus time by accounting for breaks, detects burnout signals through transparent, deterministic rules operating on week-over-week behavioural comparisons, and uses a large language model - constrained to a fixed

translated_title: RIACT：一种用于大学生个性化学习习惯追踪与早期倦怠信号检测的负责任人工智能系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21379v1 公告类型：新 摘要：学生倦怠在高等教育中非常普遍，报告发生率从12%到超过70%不等，并且始终高于工作人群——然而，它通常仅在学业衰退已经发生之后才被回顾性地识别。一个促成因素是，学生对自己学习行为的结构化可见性很低，而现有的生产力工具仅记录活动而不进行解读。本文介绍了RIACT（记录、洞察、分析、指导、追踪），一个基于网页的应用程序，它将结构化学习会话记录与混合人工智能架构相结合，以呈现个性化洞察和早期倦怠信号。学生按地点和时间记录会话；系统通过考虑休息时间计算净专注时间，通过透明、确定性的规则对周与周之间的行为比较来检测倦怠信号，并使用大型语言模型——限制在固定...
tldr: 本文提出RIACT系统，通过结合结构化学习记录、透明规则和受约束的大语言模型，实现个性化学习习惯追踪和早期倦怠信号检测，以解决学生倦怠的滞后识别问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents RIACT, a system that combines structured study logging, transparent rules, and a constrained LLM to enable personalized habit tracking and early burnout detection, addressing the delayed identification of student burnout.
